section.sectionSummaryBrief: The maamar continues that the Minchah of Shabbos and the third Shabbos meal are above the two Shabbos levels, where Zachor and Shamor are one utterance.
section.t: And it continues in the maamar,
that the Minchah of Shabbos, and likewise the third meal of Shabbos,
is above the two Shabbos levels
(Erev Shabbos and the day of Shabbos),
and until, regarding this level,
the two Shabbos levels are equal.
And this is “Zachor and Shamor were said in one utterance,”
for Zachor and Shamor are the day of Shabbos and Erev Shabbos
[Zachor is the masculine
(influencer)
—it is the day of Shabbos,
an influence from above to below,
and Shamor is the feminine
(receiver)
—it is Erev Shabbos,
an elevation from below to above],
and regarding the revelation of the level of Minchah of Shabbos,
the influencer and the receiver are equal,
Zachor and Shamor in one utterance.
And one should connect this with what we say at Minchah of Shabbos: “For from You is their rest,”
that the rest of Shabbos
(which is revealed at Minchah of Shabbos,
the ratzon of ratzons)
is “from You,”
literally from You.
And this rest includes also the rest of the day of Shabbos and of Erev Shabbos,
Zachor and Shamor.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The concept of Zachor and Shamor in one utterance in man’s service is that his fulfillment of mitzvos stems from the essence of the mitzvah itself, uniting soul and body.
section.t: And it may be said,
that the matter of Zachor and Shamor in one utterance in man’s service is,
that his fulfillment of the commandments is
[not because he is accustomed to it and habit becomes nature,
the nature of the body and the animal soul,
the lower aspect of man,
and also not because he loves Hashem and desires to cleave to Him, and it is impossible to truly cleave to Him except through fulfilling the 248 positive commandments, which are
the 248 limbs of the King,
for fulfilling the commandments in this manner is from the side of the soul
(the G-dly soul),
the higher aspect of man,
but rather his fulfillment of the commandments is]
from the side of the mitzvah itself,
mitzvah from the term tzavta and connection,
that he becomes unified and connected with the Ein Sof, the Commander of the commandments, which is above the category of higher and lower
(soul and body)
and includes both of them.
And this is the matter of Zachor and Shamor in one utterance,
that the intention of the mitzvah, which pertains to the soul
(Zachor),
and the action of the mitzvah, which pertains to the body
(Shamor),
are entirely one.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The superiority of Minchah of Shabbos over the inclusion of the two Shabbos levels is that in Minchah, intention and action are completely one, not just each including the other.
section.t: And it may be said,
that the superiority of Minchah of Shabbos over the duplication
(and the inclusion)
of the two Shabbos levels, each of which is included in the other
(as above in section 2),
is,
that in the matter of inclusion
(above there),
each one is a matter unto itself,
except that it also includes the matter of the other.
For “And you shall love Hashem your G-d” is from the side of the soul,
except that the love of the soul is drawn also into the left cavity,
and even spreads into all the faculties and limbs and is recognizable also in his portion in the world.
And the matter of the action of the commandments pertains primarily to the body of man,
except that in order for the fulfillment of the commandment to be for its own sake, it is through love and awe.
And the matter of Zachor and Shamor in one utterance at Minchah of Shabbos is that the intention of the mitzvah
(of the soul)
and the action of the mitzvah
(of the body)
are entirely one.
